question: Does ring_system_grow add unique molecular successors beyond cyclic_graft?

section3_grow_vs_cyclic_graft.ring_system_grow: cyclizes an existing chain into a ring: production structured templates have source_atoms == target_atoms (single_ring / bridged_or_fused) -> Delta_atoms=0, Delta_rings=+1. Ring-CLOSING on existing atoms.
section3_grow_vs_cyclic_graft.cyclic_graft: relocates a pendant tree fragment across a single bond -> Delta_atoms=0, Delta_rings=0 (verified: CCCc1ccccc1 16 grafts and CC(C)c1ccc(CC)cc1 34 grafts, EVERY successor (Delta_atoms,Delta_rings)=(0,0)).
section3_grow_vs_cyclic_graft.verdict: grow uniquely produces ring-count-INCREASING successors (ring closure). cyclic_graft cannot increase ring count. NOT redundant; grow is a distinct, scientifically useful lead-optimization capability (ring closure/annulation).
